title: Fake Language Models
summary: This module provides various fake chat model implementations for testing and development purposes, simulating different response behaviors without external API calls.

nodes.label: BaseChatModel
nodes.title: Base Chat Model
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class for all chat models, defining the core interface for chat interactions.

nodes.label: SimpleChatModel
nodes.title: Simple Chat Model
nodes.description: A simplified base class for chat models, providing basic implementations for common chat model functionalities.

nodes.label: FakeListChatModel
nodes.title: Fake List Chat Model
nodes.description: A fake chat model that cycles through a predefined list of string responses, useful for predictable testing scenarios.

nodes.label: FakeChatModel
nodes.title: Fake Chat Model
nodes.description: A basic fake chat model that always returns a static 'fake response', suitable for simple integration tests.

nodes.label: FakeMessagesListChatModel
nodes.title: Fake Messages List Chat Model
nodes.description: A fake chat model that cycles through a predefined list of BaseMessage objects, allowing for more complex message-based response testing.

nodes.label: ParrotFakeChatModel
nodes.title: Parrot Fake Chat Model
nodes.description: A fake chat model that 'parrots' back the last message it received, useful for testing message passing and basic conversational flow.

groups.label: Fake Implementations
groups.title: Fake Model Implementations
groups.description: Concrete implementations of fake chat models designed for various testing scenarios.
